Remove a profile from the registry; its state directory is kept

Usage: larp cc profile forget [OPTIONS] <NAME>

Arguments:
  <NAME>  Profile name

Options:
      --json                                   Emit one local metadata JSON envelope
      --yes                                    Confirm removing the profile from the registry
      --expected-revision <EXPECTED_REVISION>  Refuse if the registry revision has changed
  -h, --help                                   Print help
